security_audit.summary: The skill is a transparent DOCX generation wrapper around the jstodocx.com API. I confirmed the intentional third-party network transfer as a low-risk privacy concern and found the API key, reconnaissance, and shell-execution alerts to be documentation false positives. No prompt injection or malicious intent was found in the reviewed files.

content.user_title: Generate DOCX Files with jstodocx API
content.value_statement: Teams often need Word files from web content or structured fields without adding a local DOCX library. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through jstodocx.com API requests.
actual_capabilities: Creates Microsoft Word DOCX files through the jstodocx.com API.
Converts basic HTML headings, paragraphs, lists, and simple tables into DOCX format.
Archives JavaScript source text as a readable Word document with optional line numbers.
Builds supported template documents such as reports, invoices, proposals, resumes, and meeting notes.
Guides API key usage, common HTTP status handling, and basic DOCX response validation.
limitations: Requires network access to the jstodocx.com service.
May require a user-provided API key depending on service configuration.
Does not execute JavaScript; source mode stores code as text only.
Supports basic HTML formatting and does not promise pixel-perfect layout.

use_cases.title: Create Client Documents
use_cases.description: Generate proposal, invoice, or report DOCX files from structured fields for review and delivery.

use_cases.title: Export Web Content
use_cases.description: Turn simple HTML content into a Word document without installing a local document library.

use_cases.title: Archive Source Text
use_cases.description: Package JavaScript source as a readable Word document for audits, handoffs, or stakeholder review.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic DOCX
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple Word document.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use jstodocx-api to create a DOCX titled Release Plan from my basic HTML content. Ask before sending any sensitive content.

prompt_templates.title: Generate an Invoice
prompt_templates.prompt: Use jstodocx-api to generate an invoice DOCX from these fields: client, line items, payment terms, and footer note.

prompt_templates.title: Archive JavaScript Source
prompt_templates.scenario: Developer wants source text in a Word document.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use jstodocx-api to create a DOCX archive of this JavaScript source text with line numbers enabled.

prompt_templates.title: Build and Verify Output
prompt_templates.prompt: Use jstodocx-api to create the DOCX, save it with a clear filename, then verify content type, filename, and ZIP magic bytes.

output_examples.input: Convert a release plan from simple HTML into a Word document.
output_examples.output: A saved release-plan.docx file with headings, paragraphs, emphasis, and a short task list.

output_examples.input: Create an invoice using client details, payment terms, and line items.
output_examples.output: A downloadable invoice DOCX with a heading, summary paragraph, item table, and footer note.

output_examples.input: Archive JavaScript source text for stakeholder review.
output_examples.output: A Word document containing the source as readable text with optional line numbers.

best_practices: Confirm user approval before sending confidential or regulated content to the API.
Use placeholders or environment variables for API keys, and never log credential values.
Verify response content type, filename, and ZIP magic bytes before sharing the DOCX.
anti_patterns: Do not send protected content without explicit user confirmation.
Do not treat JavaScript source mode as code execution or validation.
Do not retry rate-limited requests aggressively or hardcode API keys.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates Microsoft Word DOCX files from basic HTML, JavaScript source text, or supported template fields.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: The endpoint may require a user-provided API key depending on service configuration.

faq.question: Can it run JavaScript code?
faq.answer: No. JavaScript source mode formats code as text inside a Word document.

faq.question: What HTML formatting is supported?
faq.answer: It supports basic headings, paragraphs, emphasis, lists, preformatted text, and simple tables.

faq.question: Is sensitive content safe to send?
faq.answer: Sensitive content should only be sent after explicit user approval because the API is a third-party service.

faq.question: How should output be checked?
faq.answer: Check the DOCX content type, filename, and ZIP magic bytes before relying on the generated file.
